description: Has this business been cited for workplace safety or wage violations? Returns U.S. Department of Labor enforcement: OSHA inspections at Texas sites since 2011 (type, dates, serious, willful and repeat violations, each citation with the standard cited, initial and current penalties, contest and final-order dates) and Wage and Hour Division cases (back wages, employees owed, civil penalties, repeat or willful FLSA findings, child labor, amounts per law), with summary totals and a way to verify each record. Neither carries a Texas taxpayer number: records with this entity's exact name and street address are returned in full; name-only matches are listed in possible_inspections and possible_cases without findings or amounts. OSHA inspects where work happens, so a contractor inspected at a job site is usually not linked: an empty list is not a clean record. Contested citations may still change. Refreshed weekly from DOL. Requires a signed-in caller (token or OAuth). Example: {"entity_id": "13624073816"}.

entity_id.description: entity_id from resolve_business (11-digit Texas taxpayer number), or a 10-digit SOS file number.

limit.description: Inspections and cases to return, each 1-50. Default 25.

since.description: Only inspections opened, or cases whose findings ended, on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: get_labor_record
title: Workplace safety and wage violations of a Texas business
